name: BIOGLOW
editionNotes: Season facts on this page come from the official FIRST LEGO League Challenge BIOGLOW Team Meeting Guide (2026). Specific robot game missions live in the Robot Game Rulebook that ships with the Challenge Set.
themeSummary: Biodiversity — how plants, animals, and ecosystems work together — shows the health of our planet. Teams use STEM, teamwork, and creativity to explore how innovation can support biodiversity and build a healthier, more connected world.

regions.name: NJ Region (FIRST Mid-Atlantic North)
regions.notes: Predicted from 2025-26: qualifiers Nov 22-23, championship Dec 13-14. Earliest region — be ready by early November!

regions.name: Hudson Valley Region
regions.notes: Predicted from 2025-26: qualifiers Jan 10-31, championship Feb 7 at RPI.

regions.name: NYC Region (NYC FIRST)
regions.notes: Predicted from past seasons: qualifiers mid-Jan to mid-Feb, NYC Championship in March.

innovationPrompt: Identify a problem that puts biodiversity at risk, and design an innovative solution that can help.
themeStory: BIOGLOW sits inside the FIRST CANOPY season. Biodiversity is a signal of planetary health: the more varied the life in an ecosystem, the more resilient it is. Scientists and engineers protect nature by observing animals, monitoring plant diversity, and building technology inspired by the natural world. This season your team takes inspiration from nature — and from each other — to design a thriving future for our shared home.

robotGame.equipment: LEGO Education SPIKE Prime set + BIOGLOW Challenge Set (mission models, challenge mat, Dual Lock fasteners)
robotGame.missionSource: Robot Game Rulebook + season mission video
robotGame.note: Mission models are built from the Challenge Set instructions and secured to the mat with Dual Lock squares. Field setup instructions are on page 7 of the Robot Game Rulebook.
